svg.desc: Wrong: fitting preprocessing on all rows before splitting lets evaluation rows shape it, and serving has to re-implement it. Right: split first, fit one Pipeline on train, save it, and serve the same object.

svg.text: The fitted object is the whole recipe, so evaluation and serving cannot diverge.
